title: Local constraints on alcohol-thioalcohol analogs in G35.2N
question: Whether the purely O-bearing alcohol ratio CH3OH/C2H5OH and the O/S alcohol-thioalcohol analog ratios CH3OH/CH3SH and C2H5OH/C2H5SH remain locally stable across selected positions within G35.2N and how they compare with other chemically rich environments and chemical models.

data.sensitivity: 0.36 mJy beam^-1 (C-5 continuum), 0.27 mJy beam^-1 (Fig. 1 continuum), ~10 mJy beam^-1 per channel (C-5 line cubes)

what.value: Spectroscopic line lists and parameters for CH3OH, 13CH3OH, CH3SH, C2H5OH, and C2H5SH from CDMS

evidence.quote: The spectroscopic information for CH$_3$OH, CH$_3$SH, C$_2$H$_5$OH, and C$_2$H$_5$SH was taken from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS; (cite: Muller2001; Muller2005))

what.value: ALMA-based molecular column densities and abundance ratios for Orion KL, Sgr B2(N2), G31.41+0.31 core and shock, and IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: References: (1) this work; (2) (cite: Tercero2018); (3) (cite: Belloche2025); (4) (cite: Mininni2023); (5) (cite: Lopez2024); (6) (cite: Jorgensen2018); (7) (cite: Drozdovskaya2018); (8) (cite: Drozdovskaya2019); (9) (cite: Lopez2025).
The observational ratios were recalculated from the molecular column densities reported in the studies listed in Table [\[tab:comparison_sample\]].

external_data.citation: (cite: Tercero2018; Belloche2025; Mininni2023; Lopez2024; Jorgensen2018; Drozdovskaya2018; Drozdovskaya2019; Lopez2025)

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and identify molecular transitions at target positions
recipe.method: Extract spectra at common positions MM3-pos, MM4-pos, MM5-pos (plus MM3-peak and MM4-peak for comparison) from C-5 spectral-line cubes and compare with CDMS synthetic spectra to identify transitions
key_parameters: Robust identification criterion: >= 3 spectrally independent unblended or marginally blended features with peak intensity > 3 sigma reproduced simultaneously by a single LTE model
assumptions: Only transitions from the ground vibrational state are considered

recipe.goal: Model spectra under LTE to derive excitation temperatures and column densities
recipe.method: Fit synthetic LTE spectra to observed unblended/minimally blended transitions using CLASS/Weeds and refine with CLASS/ADJUST, keeping theta, Delta V, and V_LSR fixed while varying T_ex and N_t; derive total CH3OH column density from 13CH3OH
key_parameters: Fixed V_LSR = 32.0 km s^-1; fixed theta = deconvolved continuum size; fixed Delta V = average linewidth from bright unblended lines; free parameters: T_ex and N_t
assumptions: 12C/13C = 50 to convert 13CH3OH column density to total CH3OH column density
Partition functions for C2H5OH and C2H5SH include both trans and gauche conformers

recipe.goal: Compute local abundance ratios and compare with literature sources and chemical models
recipe.method: Calculate column density ratios (CH3OH/C2H5OH, CH3OH/CH3SH, C2H5OH/C2H5SH, CH3SH/C2H5SH) from unrounded column densities and compare with recalculated ALMA literature ratios and Garrod (2022) warm-up chemical models
assumptions: Independent errors assumed when propagating column density uncertainties into abundance ratios

recipe.goal: Map spatial distributions and check shock diagnostics toward MM4-pos
recipe.method: Construct integrated-intensity (moment 0) maps of target species and moment 0 and moment 1 maps of shock tracers H2CO and SO, and check SiO J=5-4 peak intensity at MM4-pos
key_parameters: 3 sigma detection threshold for SiO J = 5 - 4

answer_key.quantity: Adopted total CH3OH column density at MM3-pos
Adopted total CH3OH column density at MM4-pos
Adopted total CH3OH column density at MM5-pos

not_stated_but_needed: Exact sky coordinates (RA, Dec) of the five spectral-extraction positions (MM3-pos, MM4-pos, MM5-pos, MM3-peak, MM4-peak) and whether spectra were extracted from a single pixel or averaged over an aperture
Synthesized beam sizes and position angles for each of the four C-5 spectral-line cubes
Exact numerical values of the fixed deconvolved continuum source sizes (theta) and fixed linewidths (Delta V) adopted at MM3-pos, MM4-pos, and MM5-pos in the LTE modeling
Frequency ranges of the line-free channels selected for continuum construction and continuum subtraction
Imaging cell size, image dimensions, and stopping threshold used in tclean/YCLEAN
Rest frequencies and transitions used to construct the H2CO and SO moment maps, and velocity integration ranges for all moment 0 and moment 1 maps
missing_for_reproduction: Exact sky coordinates (RA, Dec) and extraction aperture definition for MM3-pos, MM4-pos, MM5-pos, MM3-peak, and MM4-peak
Numerical values of the fixed source size (theta) and linewidth (Delta V) adopted at each position in CLASS/Weeds
Synthesized beam dimensions for the four C-5 spectral windows
Exact frequency intervals chosen for continuum subtraction
score_reason: Raw ALMA data and supplementary figures are public, calibration/imaging software and parameters (CASA 6.4.1-12, robust=0.5, 6s self-cal, YCLEAN) are stated, and all modeled transitions are tabulated in Appendix A. However, the exact coordinates of the extraction positions and the fixed source size and linewidth values used in the LTE modeling are not explicitly tabulated.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA dataset (2021.1.00713.S) with short integration time (1.5 min on-source in C-5), clear spectroscopic line lists in Appendix A, and concrete numeric column densities and abundance ratios as target answer keys, though extraction coordinates must be read from Figure 1b.
